about_the_game:
This is an era where swords and magic intertwine, a mysterious world where many races such as human elves and sea monsters live together. Ancient legends and unknown secrets await brave explorers to uncover.

Your journey will start from the magical town, which has a long history and is a place where young wizards gather to learn.

+During the semester: Students learn various magic theories and techniques in the college and participate in classroom experiments

+Summer and winter vacations: When their studies are over, students can leave the college and freely explore every corner of the continent, whether it's investigating ancient ruins, challenging harsh dungeons, or helping villages solve difficult problems. This period is a good opportunity to accumulate experience and grow.

Every choice will determine the direction of the story. Find a balance between learning and adventure, uncover the secrets deep within the continent, and write your own legendary chapter.

Daxi has been living in the tower since he had memories, and there is also a cursed mouse that can use magic beside Daxi. The story begins with Daxi leaving the tower.
